newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Mixed Australian stocks edge higher at open.
newsitem.headline: Mixed Australian stocks edge higher at open.

text.p: A mixed Australian share market edged just higher at the open on Friday as a soft resources sector sapped most Wall Street-induced strength.
Option exercises following Thursday's January series expiry inflated otherwise light turnover.
From opening, the All Ordinaries index added 4.3 points to 2,422.0.
While the base metals miners softened, the embattled gold sector suffered most, diving over 1.5 percent after the bullion price plunged again in offshore markets.
"There is not much happening," said Robert Cameron of Cameron Securities.
"Gold stocks have obviously been knocked a bit but apart from that there is not much interest."
Among the gold majors, worst hit were Acacia Resources, losing 2.7 percent to A$2.19 (US$1.67), and Newcrest Mining, down 2.6 percent to A$4.85.
Expectations were for slow pre-weekend trade. December current account data due later today was seen having little impact.
Falls outnumbered rises by a ratio of about seven to six, while about 37 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
